messages:
alex.k: Hey team — just unpacked my new MBP (m2) and trying to enroll in Kandji but SCEP cert enrollment keeps failing with 403. I'm in Manila on PLDT home ISP (CGNAT + IPv6). Anyone seen SCEP fail only when on IPv6/home NAT?

maria.it: Hi! Can you paste the exact error and the time this happened? Also are you on company VPN or trying without it?

alex.k: Error from kandji agent:
```
SCEP enrollment failed: http 403 Forbidden
Challenge mismatch: expected 8f7c... , got none
CA URL: https://ca.corp.internal/scep
```
Tried without VPN.

mdm-bot: Enrollment event: SCEP_FAILED (agent v2.1.4) — challenge_mismatch — attempt 1

sean-devops: IPv6/CGNAT sometimes breaks reachability to internal CA if NAT64/DNS64 present. Two immediate options: 1) tether phone and enroll over IPv4, 2) we can grant 2h temp local admin so you can install GlobalProtect and force route to corp. Which do you prefer?

alex.k: Tethering is doable but I'd prefer to avoid temp admin if possible. Will tether and try now.

maria.it: If tether doesn't work, ping me. For the temp admin route we need a support ticket so we can audit.

alex.k: Tethered over LTE -> re-ran enroll -> success! kandji shows device as 'Enrolled' and FileVault escrow started. thanks y'all :party_parrot:

sean-devops: Nice. If you want the VPN installed for convenience later, open a ticket and we'll grant a 2h elevation via JumpCloud.

ida-sre: For future reference you can force IPv4 in macOS with:
```
sudo networksetup -setv6off Wi-Fi
```
then re-enable with `-setv6automatic`. Use with care.

sophie-oncall: tagging for docs update — add note about SCEP and IPv6 for remote hires.

alex.k: Will do a quick note in the onboarding doc. Thanks for the quick help everyone!
